text: Eight human artifacts in one small room. All of them for the same activity: doing nothing for eight hours. Let's dig.

text: So when the sun went down, the night was really, really dark. And historian Roger Ekirch found hundreds of old diaries and letters that describe something strange. People went to bed a few hours after dark… then woke up around midnight for an hour or so. They prayed, talked, visited the neighbors, and then went back to bed. They called it "first sleep" and "second sleep."
